data.title: Here’s How Much You Would Have Made Owning Mastercard Stock In The Last 15 Years
data.description: Mastercard (NYSE:MA) has outperformed the market over the past 15 years by 8.64% on an annualized basis producing an average annual return of 21.0%. Currently, Mastercard has a market capitalization of $564.03 billion.

data.description: Elon Musk said ‘True’ to Jensen Huang’s warning that you’ll lose your job to somebody who uses AI, a day after Huang’s return to Nvidia.
